question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off embedded-agent carryover path that can send archived reset-family summaries to the selected provider, and should it land only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 or as the combined stack?
rationale: The code path is plausibly correct, but it introduces a new config flag, model-visible archived context, and a stacked protocol/history surface; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Land base first, then carryover
options.body: Merge or otherwise settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR and review only the default-off carryover provider-boundary diff.

options.title: Accept combined stack
options.body: Approve this PR as the combined includeFamily plus carryover landing path, accepting the broader protocol/config/session-state review surface in one merge.

options.title: Pause carryover experiment
options.body: Close or hold this PR after the base family-history work lands if maintainers do not want archived summaries injected into provider-bound prompts yet.

recommendation.title: Land base first, then carryover
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR and review only the default-off carryover provider-boundary diff.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the session/gateway surfaces and was explicitly asked in the PR discussion to route the stack-order and provider-boundary decision.
